tools.name: add_transaction
tools.description: Records one income or expense in an account. Confirmed by default (it already happened, date today or earlier); with forecast=true it is a planned future transaction (today or later). The amount is positive; the sign comes from `type`. Account and category ids are the ones returned by get_accounts_a

tools.name: confirm_forecast
tools.description: Marks one forecast transaction as really happened (like the ✓ button in the app), optionally with the real amount and date. Only forecasts dated today or earlier can be confirmed (list_upcoming returns them). A different amount does not change the recurring item the forecast comes from; that is upda

tools.name: get_accounts_and_categories
tools.description: Active accounts of an account book with their current balance, and the categories available for transactions, with the ids that add_transaction and search_transactions accept.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Projected balance of the accounts included in the forecast, month by month (income, expenses, end-of-month balance), the lowest projected balance and its date, accounts that go negative, and debts (what the user owes / is owed). tools.name: get_income_tax_summary
tools.description: Annual summary of the self-employed activity for the Spanish income tax return (IRPF, direct estimation): income and deductible expenses grouped by tax-return box, totals and net result, only what has already accrued. Includes documents whose accrual date is unconfirmed. Needs the self-employed modu

tools.name: get_month_summary
tools.description: Income, expenses and balance of a month (personal, self-employed and total) and the top expense and income categories. Past and current months count real transactions; future months, forecast ones. Transfers between accounts are not income or expense.

tools.name: get_tax_document
tools.description: One tax document (invoice) of the self-employed tax books, by id (from list_tax_documents): dates (invoice, operation, registration, accrual), fiscal amount, tax base and VAT (per rate when the invoice has several), VAT exemption, income-tax withholding, intra-community or reverse-charge treatment,

tools.name: get_tax_periods
tools.description: Self-employed periodic tax returns of a year as computed by Cuéntamo for the account book's tax regime (Spain: VAT form 303 and income-tax instalment form 130, or the regional/IGIC equivalents): amounts per period, payment calendar with due dates, and warnings. The figures already apply the regime's

tools.name: how_much_can_i_spend
tools.description: How much the user can spend right now without breaking their forecast: a one-off amount, an extra monthly amount and a daily amount until the next expected income (spending.daily: amount, days, until; untilIncome=false means until the 1st of next month), with and without touching their emergency cus

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: Lists the user's account books (a household, a business…): id, name, currency, the user's role, whether the self-employed tax module is available, and how many months of detailed forecast the plan shows. The other tools take one of these ids as `book`, optional when there is only one book.

tools.name: list_tax_documents
tools.description: Entries of the self-employed tax record books of a fiscal year (Spain: income, expenses, investment goods and provisions books), one per tax document (invoice), as shown in Cuéntamo: accrual and invoice dates, invoice number, fiscal amount with VAT, VAT rate(s), income-tax withholding, tax-return bo

tools.name: list_upcoming
tools.description: Forecast (not yet confirmed) transactions: the overdue ones (date already passed, waiting to be confirmed against the bank) and the ones due in the next `days` days (bills, salaries, renewals). Each row has the id that confirm_forecast accepts.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Searches transactions of an account book by text (in the concept), date range, account, category, type and status, newest first (max 50).
